name: GhostFileUploadItem
description: One list entry (li) for a File. Provides the file to GhostFileUploadItemRemove and registers for the focus-after-removal rule. Item content is consumer-owned.

props.name: file
props.description: The entry this item represents; provides context to its remove button.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Consumer content for the file, such as its name, and a GhostFileUploadItemRemove.
